objective: Certify the best Mordell-Weil rank OVER Q this program can reach from scratch, and measure the gap to the open world record of 31 on two axes: base rank over Q(t) and sieve volume.

tasks.title: Rank-8 Q(t) family, Mestre-Nagao sieve, descent certification over Q

handoff.objective: Build the record-class pipeline for rank OVER Q and report the best rank it actually certifies. Three stages: (1) construct the pencil of plane cubics through 8 rational points in general position, giving a rational elliptic surface with 8 sections over Q(t); (2) sieve Q-rational specialisations with the Mestre-Nagao statistic; (3) certify the top candidates by descent and exhibited points over Q. Then MEASURE the gap to 31 on two axes: base rank over Q(t) achieved, and sieve volume covered.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: What rank over Q this program can actually certify from scratch, and whether the binding constraint is the base rank over Q(t) or the sieve volume.
constraints: EVERY rank over Q is a certified LOWER BOUND from exhibited points on that exact curve. Never an analytic rank, never ellrank r_high, never a Selmer bound.
Silverman specialisation may motivate a search but NEVER certifies a specific curve. Recertify on the specialised curve with its own points and its own regulator.
The Mestre-Nagao statistic ORDERS candidates and nothing else. Run a random-sample control of the same size so its efficiency is measured rather than assumed.

DO NOT tune toward 31. Rank >= 31 over Q is an open world record (current record 30, Alpoge-Howell 2026). Report what you certify. An honest 12 is the deliverable; a 31 that does not verify is worthless and will be caught.
A timeout or crash is an infrastructure outcome, never negative mathematical evidence.
Write ONLY inside your write_scope. Never commit.
deliverables: the Q(t) family with its 8 sections and the regulator confirming independence
the sieve log with volume covered and the random-sample control
certified curves over Q with exhibited points and regulators, best first
the two-axis gap to 31 as numbers
completion_gate: 8x8 regulator reported and nonsingular, or the failure reported
every certified rank backed by that many exhibited points, verified in exact arithmetic by your own code
random-sample control run alongside the MN sieve
gap stated as numbers on both axes
handoff.return_format: executor execution report: what was run, what was measured, what failed. No interpretation of significance.

review_plan.claim_under_review: As the producer states it: (a) the 8-point cubic pencil is a rational elliptic surface with 8 independent sections over Q(t); (b) the best CERTIFIED rank over Q found by sieving and certifying its specialisations; (c) the measured gap to 31 on two axes, base rank over Q(t) and sieve volume.
review_plan.coordinator_prior: Recorded before any reviewer runs. The Coordinator expects P1 to HOLD (8 independent sections), P2 to hold marginally (certified rank 11-14, not more), and P3 to HOLD decisively -- nothing close to 31. The Coordinator further expects the SIEVE to look more productive than it is, because the Mestre-Nagao statistic already underperformed in GOAL-ECRANK-001. If the producer reports a large sieve yield, that is the first thing to disbelieve.

joints.joint: The 8 sections are genuinely independent, i.e. the 8 base points were in general position and the surface really has rank 8 over Q(t).
joints.attack_plan: Specialise at several independent t0 and recompute the 8x8 height regulator yourself. A dependent section set shows up as a near-singular regulator at EVERY t0, not just one. Also check the 9th base point was computed, not assumed, and that the pencil is not degenerate (a reducible member masquerading as a fibre).
joints.breaking_artifact: a singular or near-singular 8x8 regulator at multiple independent specialisations

joints.joint: Every rank reported over Q is backed by that many exhibited independent points on that exact curve.
joints.attack_plan: For each claimed curve recompute: points on curve in exact arithmetic, and the r x r regulator. Check specifically that the producer did not inherit rank from the generic fibre by Silverman specialisation without recertifying on the specialised curve -- specialisation is a theorem about all but finitely many t, and "all but finitely many" is not a certificate for the t actually used.
joints.breaking_artifact: a claimed rank whose points are fewer, dependent, or on a different curve

joints.joint: The Mestre-Nagao statistic was used ONLY to order candidates and never contributed to a certified rank.
joints.attack_plan: Trace every reported rank back to exhibited points. Then attack the sieve accounting: what fraction of certified candidates came from the top of the MN ordering versus a random sample of the same size? GOAL-ECRANK-001 measured MN ordering yielding nothing above rank 4 in the top 400 of 364756. If no random control was run, the claimed sieve efficiency is unsupported.
joints.breaking_artifact: a rank justified by an MN score, or a sieve-efficiency claim with no random control

joints.joint: The gap to 31 is measured on BOTH axes and the result is not framed as progress toward the record.
joints.attack_plan: The record is 30 (Alpoge-Howell 2026) and rests on a Q(t) base of roughly 18-20. A rank-8 base is not "most of the way" to that by any reading. Challenge any framing in which a rank-12-ish curve is presented as approaching 31, any extrapolation from sieve volume that ignores base rank, and any use of the word progress that is not attached to a number.
joints.breaking_artifact: a deliverable that reads as progress toward the record without the two-axis gap

objects: the Alpoge-Howell rank-30 curve, already re-verified by this program in RUN-ECRANK-e1e30e-003 (30 points exact, regulator 1.07e37, least eigenvalue 0.294) -- the certification harness must return exactly 30 on it, no more
a curve of KNOWN small rank, e.g. conductor 37 with rank 1, on which the harness must return 1 and not more
a specialisation deliberately chosen at a bad fibre, where the 8 sections are NOT expected to stay independent and the harness must not silently report rank 8
proves_too_much.failure_signature: On each object the harness must return the known value. A harness that reports more than 30 on the record curve, or more than 1 on the rank-1 curve, is counting dependent points and every number it produced is void.

blind_rederivation.quantity: the certified rank of the single best curve the producer reports over Q: the number of exhibited points that are pairwise independent under the Neron-Tate pairing
blind_rederivation.parameters: the a-invariants of that curve exactly as the producer reports them, and nothing else
